_README: Scout's editable filter lists. Defaults live in services/scout_config.py;
this file overrides them, so these lists can be tuned without a code change.
A key REPLACES the built-in list. A key prefixed with '+' APPENDS to it,
which is usually what you want for exclusions.
Re-read automatically when this file's mtime changes — no redeploy needed.
Run scripts/scout_coverage_baseline.py after editing: the report prints
'excluded: N' with every dropped listing and its reason, so an over-eager
_filters_note: gov.uk's own filter field names, verified against the live site:
Distance must be one of 2, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 40, all.
_watchlist_note: Employers whose listings are never silently dropped by the standard rule;
they surface in the report's 'review' group instead. Replace this with your
spreadsheet's employers — it overrides the built-in list entirely.
